service.description: The qualifications the caller reads, each as their level of projection shows it: the caller's own (mine, with PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE), one person's (partyId), one qualification (partyQualificationId), or those of everyone the caller's scope reaches (a staff reader's employers' current employees, organizationPartyId narrowing them; a manager's live reports). The person and HR of an employer of theirs read every field (the reference of an identity document or work permit theirs alone); development every field but those references; a manager and other staff readers only verified qualifications, as their type, dates and validity. show: all, waiting (submitted, not decided), valid, expiring (verified, expiring within thirty days), expired, attention (verified and expiring or expired, not renewed by a later verified one); qualificationTypeEnumId narrows to a type and those under it, term to the people named. Paged, with an export (pageNoLimit). Refuses a caller who reads no one (PERMISSION_DENIED), a person or qualification not in scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), an employer outside it (ORGANIZATION_DENIED) and a show that is not one (SHOW_INVALID).

service.description: A qualification submitted (partyId, the caller's own when empty), or one waiting or rejected changed and submitted again (partyQualificationId, at the revision read): its type, title, issuer, reference, issued and expiry dates and comments, and the earlier qualification it renews; it waits for verification. Submitted by the person, an HR editor (PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT) of an employer of theirs, or a development editor (PEOPLE_DEVELOP_VIEW and PEOPLE_DEVELOP_EDIT) for a type that is not an identity document or work permit. Refuses a person or qualification not in scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), another caller (PERMISSION_DENIED), no type, not one or ended (TYPE_REQUIRED, TYPE_INVALID, VALUE_ENDED), an identity document or work permit with no expiry (EXPIRY_REQUIRED), an expiry not after the issue (DATES_INVALID), a renewal of another person's or kind's (RENEWAL_INVALID), a change of a verified or revoked one, which is renewed instead (QUALIFICATION_DECIDED), and a revision other than the one read (REVISION_CHANGED).

A waiting qualification verified (decision verify) or rejected (reject), or a verified one revoked (revoke), at the revision read; the state is audit-logged with the reason. A verifier is an HR editor of an employer of the person, or a development editor for a type that is not an identity document or work permit, and never the person. Refuses one not in scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), another caller (PERMISSION_DENIED), the caller's own (SELF_APPROVAL), a decision that is not one (DECISION_INVALID), verifying or rejecting one not waiting (NOT_PENDING), revoking one not verified (NOT_VERIFIED), a rejection or revocation with no reason (REASON_REQUIRED) and a revision other than the one read (REVISION_CHANGED).

Whether the caller reads a qualification's files: the person and an HR reader (PEOPLE_HR_VIEW) of an employer of theirs in scope; canEdit for an HR editor of another person's, and for the person while it waits or was rejected. Never refuses: a qualification that is not one, or not the caller's to read, answers recordVisible false, and so does a call with no user. get#RecordLinkInfo and RecordFiles read it.

A file of a qualification (PartyQualificationContent, the record files of get#RecordLinkInfo): the row, and the uploaded file saved through save#QualificationContentFile. Needs the person while it waits or was rejected, or an HR editor of an employer of theirs (check#QualificationAccess: RECORD_UNAVAILABLE outside the scope, PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise).
Internal to create#QualificationContent, which checks the caller: the file of a PartyQualificationContent row of that qualification.

service.description: Whether people meet requirements at a date (asOfDate, the planned work date; now when empty): those of a job class (emplPositionClassId), a work effort's skill standards (workEffortId, their minimumSkillLevel), or one skill (skillTypeEnumId, minimumLevel) and qualification type (qualificationTypeEnumId); with none named, each person's own job class's. For each person (partyIdList or partyId, up to 500) each requirement is qualified, expiring (a verified qualification expiring within thirty days), missing or expired, with the reason in words ("Self-declared only", "Waiting for verification", "Expired 2026-10-01", a level below the least), and the person's state is the worst of the required ones. A self-declared level and an unverified, rejected or revoked qualification meet nothing. The staffing projection, the same for every caller: never a reference, issuer, title, decision reason or file. A person the caller's People scope does not admit answers state unavailable and nothing else; a caller with no People reach is refused (PERMISSION_DENIED), and a job class that is not one (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

parameter.description: partyId, personName, state, stateText, requirements: [{skillTypeEnumId, skillName, minimumLevel, minimumLevelText, qualificationTypeEnumId, qualificationTypeName, required, state, stateText, explanation, validThruText}]

service.description: A person's level of a skill (skillLevel, a SkillLevel value's number) as a self-declaration (the person, PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE; the caller's own skill is always one) or an evaluation (a development editor, PEOPLE_DEVELOP_EDIT, reading the person as a development reader of an employer of theirs or as their manager; or, the user's call of Nov 12, 2026, a manager of a live reporting line without PEOPLE_DEVELOP_EDIT, recorded as the manager's evaluation, SksManagerEvaluated, which meets a requirement as an evaluation does), with its date (now when empty, never later), evidence and a qualification of the person it rests on; each kept as a PartySkillEvaluation, the caller its assessor. PartySkill takes an evaluation, and a self-declaration only where no evaluation or earlier recorded level has set it (accepted says which). Refuses a person not in scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), another caller (PERMISSION_DENIED), no skill, not one or ended (SKILL_REQUIRED, SKILL_INVALID, VALUE_ENDED), a level that is not a current one (LEVEL_INVALID), a date after now (DATE_INVALID), evidence that is not the person's (QUALIFICATION_INVALID) and a revision other than the one read (REVISION_CHANGED).

People by skill: the requirements of a job class (emplPositionClassId), else one skill (skillTypeEnumId), else the requirements of the page's people's job classes and the skills they hold, as columns; each cell the person's level (self-declared labelled so) and whether it meets the person's requirement (met, gap, held, none), a requirement a qualification proves with that qualification's validity. The people: a development or HR reader's employers' current employees (organizationPartyId narrows them) and a manager's live reports, narrowed to a unit and the units under it (unitPartyId, current memberships), a job class and a name (term); paged by person. Refuses a caller who reads no one's skills (PERMISSION_DENIED) and an employer outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).

With what the caller may change: declare (the person), evaluate (a development editor, or a manager of a live line), submit a qualification, change the resume. Refuses a person not in scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE); checkOnly answers visible false instead.

service.description: A resume line (PartyResume) added (partyId, the caller's own when empty), changed (partyResumeId) or removed (remove) by the person or an HR or development editor of an employer of theirs: its type (experience, education, other), organization, role, dates and description. Refuses a person or line not in scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), another caller (PERMISSION_DENIED), a type that is not one (TYPE_INVALID), no organization or role (DESCRIPTION_REQUIRED) and an end before the start (DATES_INVALID).

Each verified qualification expiring within thirty days and not renewed by a later verified one, whose person was not yet reminded of that expiry, reminded once (the QualificationExpiring topic, to the person's own accounts: its type and expiry, never its reference) and marked (reminderThruDate); each in its own transaction, a failing one logged by its id and the rest going on. A rerun sends nothing again for the same expiry.
